Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of the Act empowers the Government to amend customs notifications in the public interest and in consultation with the National Board of Revenue.
National Board of Revenue: The Board acts as a consultative body to the Government for the issuance and amendment of customs notifications.
S.R.O. 127-AIN/2020/78/Customs: This existing customs notification is being amended through this new S.R.O. to update specific tariff headings.
Table: The table within the notification is amended by replacing existing entries for specific tariff headings with new chemical and industrial product descriptions.
Specific commodity classifications under headings for halogenated derivatives of hydrocarbons, surface-active agents, and polyacetals are updated to ensure accurate tariff application.
